designOwnership: Own visual language, light/dark wallpaper-derived palette and motion; reference editing workflows and commands, not copied commercial UI/code

mainTrackMagnetism.semantics: Closing and opening gaps, insertion, reorder, deletion and linked items follow one consistent edit model

snapping.feedback: Single stable guide and predictable threshold, with temporary bypass

timeline.linkedTracks: Source-associated overlays follow relevant edits unless deliberately detached; one undo group per user gesture
timeline.selection: Stable object identity across reorder, split and undo; visible range, zoom and scroll preserved

rules: same command and keyboard binding across toolbar/menu
right click must not move or split content

shape.policy: fast hotspot-aligned complementary crossfade; no drifting or slow morph through unrelated geometry
shape.timing: shorter than page and numeric-property transitions; final duration tuned in actual use

visibility.policy: brief continuous reveal/hide with existing visual language; no abrupt pop

numeric.policy: continuous rendered output and velocity where relevant, not resetting the solver at clip boundaries

discrete.policy: blend rendered states rather than interpolate incompatible enums

transitions.hotspot: Pointer contact point stays anchored during size, style, shadow and image changes
transitions.seek: Deterministic evaluation from timeline time, independent of play/seek history
transitions.desyncedSource: Badge remains visible; visual blending does not pretend alignment was corrected

verificationPhilosophy: Necessary functional checks plus real interaction and visual review; do not substitute extensive defensive tests for product quality
